label: debug
note: Before the runner and this log existed, replication 0 of D01 and of P3 at STD was run once each by calling the pipeline directly on uncommitted code, to see that it ran end to end and to time it (about 57 s each). Their numbers were printed, not kept, and are superseded by the logged runs that follow. About 1,200 single-family SPA calls on i.i.d. noise were also made to check the test's size outside the pipeline. No held-out scenario was run.
